name: FSLmaths-app
summary: Combines one ROI from each of two ROI sets with FSL fslmaths (add, subtract, multiply, divide or mask), for example to remove a lesion from a region of interest.
description: Copies the named ROI from each input ROI directory and runs fslmaths <roi_1> -<function> <roi_2>, writing the result as a new ROI; with sub the result is clipped to 0-1 so it stays binary. Use it to mask an ROI by a lesion or to merge or intersect ROIs. Both ROIs must be on the same voxel grid; with sub the order of inputs matters.

inputs.description: If you want to subtract, the order of inputs matters (first ROI is manipulated). For other functions it does not.
ROI directory containing the second ROI (roi_2), e.g. a lesion mask, applied to the first.

outputs.description: ROI directory with copies of both input ROIs and the result <output_roi_name>.nii.gz.

parameters.description: File name (without .nii.gz) of the ROI to take from the first ROI input.
fslmaths operation applied as roi_1 -<function> roi_2: add, sub (subtract, then clipped to 0-1), mul, div or mas (mask).
File name (without .nii.gz) of the ROI to take from the second ROI input.
File name (without .nii.gz) for the resulting ROI.
